GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-11-28T10:00:15Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Should a disposed ConnectableObservable replay() still emit?
Description: I have this test which passes, but I initially expected it (in particular the 2nd `test`) to fail:

```java
@Test
public void connectableReplay() throws Exception {
    ConnectableObservable<Integer> just = Observable.just(1).replay();

    just.test().assertNoValues();

    Disposable connect = just.connect();
    connect.dispose();

    just.test()
            .assertValue(1)
            .assertComplete();
}
```

So even after a `replay()` ConnectableObservable was disposed it can still emit it's replayed values? Is that the desired behaviour?
